headline: Archduke Franz Ferdinand Shot Dead in Sarajevo; Wife Also Slain
dispatch: Archduke Franz Ferdinand, heir to the Austro-Hungarian throne, was shot and killed today in Sarajevo alongside his wife Sophie, Duchess of Hohenberg. The assassin, identified as Gavrilo Princip, fired at point-blank range as the archduke's motorcade paused on Franz Josef Street. The killings have sent shockwaves through every European capital, with diplomatic cables burning the wires between Vienna, Berlin, and St. Petersburg.
answer: Archduke Franz Ferdinand assassinated in Sarajevo, 1914
